title: "About Me"
toc: true
---

Hey there! 👋 I'm Laura. 

When I'm not at my computer you can find me with my nose in a book (both fiction and non-fiction), listening to a podcast, running along trails, trying to grow enough basil to make "fresh" pesto year round, painting, drawing or making linoleum relief prints. 

I have enjoyed taking advantage of the international nature of a career in science and have lived in the UK, US, Austria and Australia.

I love working with **data** - sifting through noisy and complex datasets to glean some insight and making informative and aesthetically-pleasing plots. 

I also think knowledge should be accessible and try and implement FAIR (findable, accessible, interoperable and reusable) principles in all aspects of my work.
